about.en: FC Porto Fan Token (PORTO) is the fan token of the Portuguese football club FC Porto, launched by Binance through its Fan Token platform as a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0x49f2145d6366099e13b10fbf80646c0f377ee7f6. Holders use it on Binance to vote in club polls and to access rewards and fan experiences; it gives no ownership of the club.
